outputs.explanation: Panel A contains only micrographs (fluorescence images of MitoTracker/DsRed/GFP staining); no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel B includes bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity Green/Red, and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing mean ± error bars (n=20) without any overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image; no averaged plot is displayed.
Panel D contains bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity (mean ± error bars, n indicated in bars) with no individual data points shown.
Panel E shows FACS histogram plots (cell number vs TMRM intensity), which are distribution/line-type plots where overlaying individual points is not applicable or meaningful.
